newsitem.title: ITALY: Italian parlt continues study of 1997 budget.
newsitem.headline: Italian parlt continues study of 1997 budget.

text.p: Italy's lower house of parliament is continuing to examine the 1997 budget, but will not study at present those articles where the government has asked for proxy powers, parliamentary party leaders said on Thursday.

The opposition centre-right bloc has demanded that the government drop some 27 requests for special powers, which if approved, would allow it to dictate policy on several sensitive budget areas without needing subsequent parliamentary approval.
Prime Minister Romano Prodi said earlier on Friday he was ready to forego some of the requests and the government was due to release a full list of proxies it was prepared to let go later in the day.

The opposition said it would carry on examining the budget until Friday evening. Work will halt on Saturday because the centre-right has called a large demonstration in Rome to protest against the budget, but resume again on Sunday.

The lower house has so far approved 11 of some 70 budget articles. It has until November 14 to ratify the whole bill after while the package goes to the upper house (Senate) for a further reading. -- Rome newsroom +396 6782501
